description: MCP Secure deterministic policy ruleset v1. This file's SHA-256 is stored in every ScanRecord to guarantee reproducibility.

AST_TAINT.description: Command injection via tainted sink reachability. A single confirmed hit causes an immediate FAIL regardless of other analyzers.

MODEL_A_TEXT.description: Simulated fine-tuned text model detecting tool-poisoning and prompt-manipulation attacks (PMA) in tool descriptions.

MODEL_B_CODE.description: Model B v8: fine-tuned code model (UniXcoder + LoRA) scoring every function for command injection, path traversal, SSRF, code injection, SQL injection and unsafe deserialization. Served by model_b_service/ (set MODEL_B_URL); simulated heuristic when unset.
